exposure: Risk factors for fetal hypoxia (categorized as low-risk and high-risk)
cohort: 100 term antenatal women admitted to the labor ward in the first stage of labor
finding: The study found that admission CTG was effective in detecting fetal hypoxia in both low- and high-risk pregnancies and was significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery in both risk groups with ominous CTG tracing.
